title: Permission and status limits apply to every work order drag
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in on the Work Orders build under test with Work Orders view permission; the Board View and Tech View display options are on.
  2. The current location has at least 3 lead technicians shown as groups/columns (a technician is eligible when they are Clockable, Active, and their role is not Office or Time Clock User).
  3. Via New Work Order, create several work orders and set a Lead Technician on each, spread across the technicians with some left Unassigned; then open the Work Orders page.
  4. A view-only user and work orders in prohibited statuses.
custom_steps:
1. As a view-only user, try to drag a work order and confirm it is blocked.
  2. As a create-and-edit user, try to drag a prohibited-status work order and confirm it is blocked.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The Story 4 permission and status restrictions apply to every work-order drag.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043 (Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options). Story reference: SV-10052 — Story 9 Drag to reorder.
